provenance.solos: The three solos were cut from a single AUTHOR-SUPPLIED three-panel sheet by splitting it in equal thirds. No retouching, no recolouring, no regeneration.

rulings.supersedesPage13ForProps: packet_v2/page-13.png remains the approved ступа DESIGN, but it shows Яга standing inside the ступа. Binding it to a shot whose rule is that she is never inside it hands the model a picture that contradicts the instruction. These plates replace it as the prop bindings.
rulings.emptyIsTheIndoorState: Indoors the ступа stands empty and upright on its foot and she stands on the floor beside it. She rides in it; she does not stand in it in the house.
rulings.broomIsNotPomelo: The two sticks are different objects and are now bound separately so they can never be conflated: @BROOM is a twig besom, @POMELO is a rag mop. One shared image previously left the model to guess which was which.
rulings.threeItemsTravelTogether: All three objects arrive together and stay together. Any shot where she arrives or departs must show all three.
